meta.title: Aurelia demo store
meta.description: The Aurelia block theme and Aurelia Commerce plugin with WooCommerce and the full demo store.
meta.author: calculatewellhub-cell

steps.data:
<?php
// Playground demo only. Playground runs on SQLite, which cannot run WooCommerce's
// checkout stock-hold query, so skip holds here. Real hosting (MySQL/MariaDB) needs none of this.
add_filter( 'woocommerce_hold_stock_for_checkout', '__return_false' );
// Keep the demo on the storefront instead of the setup wizard redirect.
add_action( 'admin_init', static function () { delete_transient( 'aurelia_commerce_activation_redirect' ); }, 1 );

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$importer = new \Aurelia\Commerce\Demo_Importer();
foreach ( \Aurelia\Commerce\Demo_Importer::steps() as $step ) {
	echo $step, ': ', $importer->run( $step ), "\n";
}
// Demo-only contact and payment values that cannot reach a real person:
// WhatsApp rejects 910000000000 as invalid, and no UPI provider uses the @example handle.
\Aurelia\Commerce\Settings::update( array( 'wa_number' => '910000000000', 'wa_enabled' => 1 ) );
update_option(
	'woocommerce_aurelia_upi_settings',
	array_merge(
		(array) get_option( 'woocommerce_aurelia_upi_settings', array() ),
		array( 'enabled' => 'yes', 'upi_id' => 'demo.store@example', 'payee_name' => 'Aurelia Demo' )
	)
);
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'skipped' => true ) );
delete_transient( 'aurelia_commerce_activation_redirect' );
flush_rewrite_rules( false );
